confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Granada and Andalusian tourist pricing, with no live listings or booking pages checked. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the most reliable. Accommodation anchors are less certain because July is peak season for Granada (Alhambra demand), and tourist tax and VAT treatment vary by property. Drink anchors are based on typical Spanish bar pricing, with the cocktail and wine anchors set relative to the beer anchor. The FX value comes from search summaries that cite the RBA rate for 15 October 2026. I did not confirm it against the RBA F11 table itself, and a secondary source gave a slightly different figure for 16 October.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Andalusian tourist cities such as Seville, Málaga and Córdoba. Granada's tapas culture keeps drink and casual meal prices below Madrid and Barcelona levels, while Alhambra-driven summer demand pushes accommodation toward the upper end of the regional range.
